title: PLAINSIGHT connector harness fixture
description: Lints one harness fixture: one line of a connector's fixtures JSONL file. A fixture names the connector at a version, gives the adapter an input made of placeholders, and pins what the adapter must return: events with an exact count, or a refusal with a declared code. An unknown key is a caught typo rather than a silent no-op (docs/PLAINSIGHT-FOUNDATION.md section 4.4).
$comment: HAND-WRITTEN at Step 12. Rank 3, Class B. Read by tools/validate_manifest.py, which checks every line of every fixtures file a manifest's refusal_fixtures name, and by tools/validate_connector_conformance.py, which arrives with the first connector and calls the adapter. event_count is required whenever result is events, because without it a refusing adapter satisfies every expectation vacuously (docs/THE-GAMEPLAN.md section 2.1). adapter_state equals spec/layer-model.yaml PROBE_EVENT error_class, canary_subject_class equals the manifest schema's, and the input pattern equals tools/validate_cast.py PLACEHOLDER_RE; tools/validate_manifest.py reconciles all three on every run. That tool also refuses a line that repeats a key and an input that is neither a slot name nor a typed token synthetic/GROUND_TRUTH.yaml carries (MF-R8). MF-R15: a fixture pins an event count or a refusal code and nothing else; docs/PLAINSIGHT-FOUNDATION.md section 4.4 also names presence, absence, lineage and forbidden_paths, which have no key here yet and are refused as unknown keys until the runner that reads them adds them.

id.description: Unique within the fixtures file. A manifest's refusal_fixtures entry names it.

input.description: Keyed by the consumed input's as name. Every value is a placeholder in the cast grammar, or null to assert refusal on a present but empty input. tools/validate_manifest.py narrows the placeholder to a slot name or a typed token the cast carries (MF-R8). A fixture never carries a selector value, because a fixture is a tracked file and git history is the one store a crypto-shred cannot reach (doctrine/RETENTION.md RT-15).

result.description: events: the adapter returns events and event_count pins how many, including zero. refusal: the adapter refuses with [] because the input cannot honestly become an event, and refusal_code names why.

adapter_state.description: The adapter's classification of what occurred, from the fixed enum. Adapter code decides it and never a YAML regex (docs/PLAINSIGHT-design.md section 6.3).

refusal_code.description: A code declared in spec/layer-model.yaml violation_codes. tools/validate_manifest.py checks membership, so the vocabulary is read from the layer model rather than copied.

cassette.description: Path to the recorded exchange the adapter replays, relative to the connector's directory. Captured against an S2 or N0 target only, where it is stratum 4 (doctrine/RETENTION.md RT-1).

canary_subject_class.description: Who the cassette was captured against. synthetic or institutional only (RT-15); consented is deliberately absent.
